channel.title: reranker.uk changelog
channel.description: Release notes for reranker.uk — demo features, guides, and site improvements.

item.title: 3 Oct 2026 — The RAG guide's model picks, corrected; the Chinese pages, finished
item.description: The RAG guide's model recommendations called bge-reranker-v2-m3 English-only and pointed at Cohere Rerank v3.5 and Voyage Rerank 2; they now match the model pages. Remaining English on the Chinese pages — tables of contents, a diagram, table source notes, demo hints — is translated.

item.title: 2 Oct 2026 — Structured data that matches the page
item.description: Five pages carried hidden FAQ markup that still repeated claims the site had withdrawn; it's removed. Structured data on every page, including the Chinese ones, is now generated from the page's own title and description, and a CI check keeps it that way.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — The demo recovers when the mirror can’t serve
item.description: If hf-mirror.com wins the demo's host race but can't serve the files (outside mainland China it redirects to huggingface.co without CORS headers), the demo now retries once on the other host. The daily real-network check covers that path, and every page is now checked for CSP violations in CI.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — The demo scores about twice as fast
item.description: The demo pages are now cross-origin isolated, so ONNX Runtime Web scores on several threads: about 1.9x faster in a same-machine A/B. Isolation and a blob:-permitting CSP apply to the demo pages only, and a daily check confirms the live headers.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — Latency figures measured, or sourced, or gone
item.description: The browser demo's three models are now measured on a GitHub runner (about 0.4–1.4 s for 10 passages, not the 30–150 ms the site claimed), and two of the demo's download sizes are corrected. mixedbread's and Jina's published latencies are cited; unsourced CPU/GPU figures are removed.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — Qwen3, Contextual AI, GTE and NVIDIA rows checked against their model cards
item.description: Contextual AI Rerank v2 is open-weight (non-commercial) and multilingual, not an English-only API. Unsourced Hit@1 figures for NVIDIA and GTE removed; GTE shows Alibaba's 56.19 BEIR. Qwen3 rows show Qwen's own MTEB-R, the 4B-vs-8B claim is corrected, and the Qwen page gains Qwen's full score table and instruction usage.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — Cohere's 500-token rule, and Voyage rerank-3
item.description: Correction: Cohere does bill documents over 500 tokens as several, per its own pricing FAQ — this site said otherwise in September, and the cost calculator now models it. Voyage rerank-3 is now Voyage's recommended reranker, not a preview. Cohere and Voyage prices are sourced in data/models.json and checked daily.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — jina-reranker-v3.5, and Jina's licences spelled out
item.description: jina-reranker-v3.5 added (0.6B listwise, 63.20 BEIR in Jina's own test). Jina's v2, v3, v3.5 and m0 weights are now labelled CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial. "Jina v3 beats Qwen3-Reranker-4B" withdrawn after Jina's own 2026 re-run, and unsourced Jina prices removed.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — bge-reranker's BEIR figure, and a daily check on every source
item.description: bge-reranker-v2-m3 corrected from an untraceable ~60.1 to BAAI's own 55.36, and the bge page's benchmark table rebuilt from what BAAI published. Jina v1 tiny and ms-marco MiniLM-L6 now show Jina's published BEIR figures. The footnote no longer claims a common BEIR protocol, and a daily job re-checks every figure against its source.

item.title: 1 Oct 2026 — An accessibility pass, and a check to keep it
item.description: Links in running text are underlined, five low-contrast text colours fixed, wide code blocks keyboard-scrollable. Every build now runs axe-core's WCAG 2.1 AA rules on all 48 pages in both themes: over 400 issues on the first run, none now.

item.title: 28 Sep 2026 — transformers.js 4.3.0, and what report-only caught
item.description: The demo moves to transformers.js 4.3.0, verified on all three demo models against live infrastructure. The report-only CSP's first real run caught HuggingFace's CDN redirects and transformers.js 4's blob: import, both fixed before the policy is ever enforced.

item.title: 27 Sep 2026 — Security headers, report-only for now
item.description: Added public/_headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and a report-only CSP), generated at build time with a script-src hash computed from the site's one inline script. Both smoke tests now assert zero CSP violations.

item.title: 26 Sep 2026 — ms-marco MiniLM's BEIR figure was never published
item.description: ms-marco MiniLM-L6 now reads "not published" in the model comparison table — sentence-transformers' own docs report TREC DL 19 NDCG@10, not a BEIR average, so the ~55.0 this table carried had no source.

item.title: 26 Sep 2026 — mxbai-rerank-v2, a corrected BEIR figure, and a demo smoke test
item.description: mxbai-rerank-large-v1's BEIR figure corrected from an unsourced ~62.1 to mixedbread's own 49.32; mxbai-rerank-v2 (multilingual, incl. Chinese) added to the table; benchmark facts now live in a sourced data/models.json; a Playwright smoke test now covers the live demo.

item.title: 18 Sep 2026 — URLs without the .html, and two pricing corrections
item.description: Internal URLs dropped .html; Voyage's free-token grant moved to rerank-3, added to the table and calculator; a token-formula bug and a Cohere chunking myth both corrected; homepage diagram translated; model table made screen-reader friendly.

item.title: 25 Aug 2026 — Two guides for the questions people actually ask
item.description: New troubleshooting guide for rerankers that show no lift, and a guide to wiring a rerank stage onto pgvector, Qdrant or Elasticsearch. Plus a generated /llms.txt and sitewide RSS autodiscovery.

item.title: 14 Aug 2026 — Cost calculator, and demo links that land somewhere
item.description: New rerank cost calculator comparing Cohere per-search and Voyage per-token billing; demo links across every guide now open the relevant scenario via ?s=.

item.title: 11 Aug 2026 — Real Chinese URLs, and a 2026 model refresh
item.description: Chinese pre-rendered at /zh/ with real hreflang; generated sitemap; Cohere Rerank 4, Voyage rerank-2.5, Jina v3 BEIR 61.94; design refresh.

item.title: 25 Jun 2026 — Model landscape refresh
item.description: Qwen3 family + deep page; Jina v3 listwise; GTE ModernBERT; NVIDIA; honest score footnotes.

item.title: 25 Jun 2026 — Minimal polish pack
item.description: Honest benchmarks; demo max_length; lazy transformers.js; instruction-rerank guide; homepage beyond five families.

item.title: 25 Jun 2026 — Content expansion & polish
item.description: Architecture column on models table; Qwen3, Contextual AI, ColBERT rows; late-interaction guide; 7 demo presets; JSON-LD inLanguage; changelog RSS.

item.title: 25 Jun 2026 — i18n & SEO completion
item.description: Model page i18n gaps; changelog & privacy Chinese; hreflang tags; og:locale:alternate.

item.title: 25 Jun 2026 — Low-priority polish
item.description: Guide i18n; gzip share links; preset mobile layout; dual-diff a11y.
